element_scores.name: Dataset Discovery and Identification
element_scores.description: Can a user or system discover and uniquely identify this dataset?

sub_elements.name: Persistent Identifier (DOI, RRID, or URI)
sub_elements.quality_note: Valid DOI with correct format (10.18130 prefix matches Harvard Dataverse/UVA LibraData). Multiple additional DOIs provided for version releases.

sub_elements.name: Dataset Title and Description Completeness
sub_elements.evidence: title: Cell Maps for Artificial Intelligence (CM4AI); description: 1,820 characters covering mission, data types, cell lines, multimodal integration, MuSIC pipeline, RO-Crate packaging, and Nature publication
sub_elements.quality_note: Comprehensive description with specific technical details: 100 chromatin modifiers, 100 metabolic enzymes, multiple data streams (IF, AP-MS, SEC-MS, CRISPR), cell lines (MDA-MB-468, KOLF2.1J), and peer-reviewed validation (Nature 2025)

sub_elements.name: Keywords or Tags for Searchability
sub_elements.evidence: keywords: 26 terms including Cell Maps, AI-Ready Data, Bridge2AI, Functional Genomics, Protein-Protein Interactions, Spatial Proteomics, CRISPR Perturbation, specific cell lines (MDA-MB-468, KOLF2.1J), techniques (AP-MS, SEC-MS, Immunofluorescence), standards (FAIR, RO-Crate, FAIRSCAPE), methods (Deep Learning, Integrative Structure Modeling)
sub_elements.quality_note: Excellent coverage: domain (functional genomics), methods (AP-MS, SEC-MS, IF, CRISPR), cell types (breast cancer, iPSC), standards (FAIR, RO-Crate), diseases (Breast Cancer), and techniques (Deep Learning, Visible Neural Networks)

sub_elements.name: Landing Page and Resources (page, hierarchical resources)
sub_elements.evidence: page: https://www.cm4ai.org; distribution_formats with access_urls including DOI landing pages, NDEx, U-BRITE platform, MassIVE, NCBI SRA
sub_elements.quality_note: Official project website plus multiple access points: UVA Dataverse (DOIs with landing pages), NDEx for visualization, MassIVE for MS data, NCBI SRA for sequence data. Hierarchical resource structure via RO-Crate packages.

sub_elements.name: Hierarchical Structure (parent datasets, relationships)
sub_elements.evidence: RO-Crate packages with hierarchical structure; multiple release versions (V0.5, V1.4, V2.1, October 2025); subsets defined (IF images, AP-MS, SEC-MS, CRISPR atlas, MuSIC cell maps); instances organized by cell line and treatment condition
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear hierarchical organization: project-level RO-Crates containing data subsets, versioned releases with DOIs, parent-child relationships between raw data and integrated cell maps. Temporal versioning with quarterly updates.
